paper_contract.figure_simulator_scope: gate and measurement errors in addition to injected Pauli errors

source_trace.location: main text p. 3 and Main Fig. 2 caption
source_trace.finding: The injection law and p=8.8% are printed, while the dashed Fig. 2(c) curves are explicitly described as simulations with gate and measurement errors.

The 64 weighted injection circuits and processor-level median/mean/stdev summaries are printed, but no circuit-location-resolved gate channel, readout channel, correlation model, or simulator composition is supplied.

indispensable_missing_inputs: circuit-location-resolved one- and two-qubit error channels
qubit-resolved preparation and measurement error channels
correlation and composition rules used by the Fig. 2(c) simulator
the exact calibration snapshot bound to the simulated circuit

scientific_boundary.conclusion: The disclosed injection mechanism is independently reproduced, but the paper-exact Fig. 2(c) simulation curves cannot be uniquely generated from the published calibration summaries.
